missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Паспорт' is the masculine nominative subject. 'Мой' and 'новый' agree in the masculine nominative. A basic identification phrase.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Паспорт' is the accusative direct object of 'покажите'; inanimate masculine accusative equals the nominative. 'Ваш' agrees in the masculine accusative. A standard request.

missions.phrase: У меня нет с собой паспорта.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Паспорта' takes the genitive after 'нет', denying possession. 'С собой' means on hand. A very practical travel phrase.

missions.phrase: В паспорте есть фотография и подпись.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Паспорте' is prepositional after 'в', the document within which the items are. 'Фотография и подпись' are the nominative subjects. A descriptive pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Паспорта' is the genitive modifying 'срок', the validity of what. 'Скоро' adds time. A useful renewal-related phrase.

missions.phrase: Я подошёл к окну с паспортом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'Паспортом' is instrumental after 'с', the thing carried. 'К окну' shows direction. A natural office-counter scene.

missions.phrase: Я отдал документы вместе с паспортом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'Паспортом' is instrumental after 'вместе с', accompanying the other documents. 'Документы' is the accusative object. A bureaucratic phrase.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Паспорт' is the accusative object of 'положи', and 'в верхний ящик' uses the accusative for motion into. A clear storage instruction.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Паспорта' is the nominative plural subject of 'лежат'; note the stressed '-а' plural typical of this noun. 'Все' is the agreeing quantifier.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Паспортов' is the genitive plural after 'несколько', expressing an indefinite count. 'Подряд' means in a row. A checkpoint scene.
